plugin.note: Supreme is the ranged Dagannoth King and is killed with Melee. It is close to Prime and Rex, so control aggression and use Protect from Missiles when Supreme is the active threat.

requirements: Dagannoth task or Boss task where applicable for Slayer helmet bonuses
Rune thrownaxe and pet rock, a partner, or the 85 Agility shortcut to reach the Kings
70+ Attack and Strength recommended; higher stats and switches for tribrid
Antipoison or serpentine helm for Spinolyp poison
Elite Fremennik Diary strongly recommended for noted Dagannoth bones
mechanics: Dagannoth Supreme uses ranged attacks and is killed with Melee.
Supreme can hit multiple players if facing their direction.
Dagannoth Prime uses magic and is the highest-priority prayer threat.
Dagannoth Rex uses melee and can be safespotted with Magic.
Spinolyps poison and drain Prayer around the island.
Supreme is close to Prime and Rex, so bad positioning can draw multiple Kings.

methods.label: Kings overview
methods.summary: Use Melee for Supreme, Ranged for Prime, and Magic for Rex while minimising overlapping aggression.
steps: Kill Supreme with Melee when it is safe to approach.
Avoid standing where Prime or Rex will also target you.
Use Protect from Missiles against Supreme unless Prime is the immediate lethal threat.
Return to Rex or Prime positions before respawns overlap.

methods.label: Entering the lair
methods.summary: Enter with Protect from Magic active, then choose whether Supreme is safe enough to kill first.
steps: Activate Protect from Magic before entering.
If Prime is not aggressive, attempt Supreme first only when you can kill it quickly.
If Supreme or Prime pressure is unsafe, move to the eastern wall and start with Rex instead.
Avoid Supreme's spawn location when it would cause extra Kings to notice you.
risks: Starting with Supreme is typically the most difficult option.

methods.label: Handling multicombat
methods.summary: Use prayer swaps or camp Protect from Magic while killing Supreme quickly to reduce multi-King damage.
steps: If several Kings attack, off-tick them and pray correctly when possible.
When unsure, keep Protect from Magic active and focus Supreme down quickly.
Use strong melee armour and high defence to tank Supreme/Rex while Prime is prayed against.
Move back to safespots or long-range positions as soon as Supreme dies.

methods.label: Tribrid safe rotation
methods.summary: Kill Rex east, Prime north, then Supreme south/west while staying away from Rex's respawn.
steps: Move to the east wall and safespot Rex with Magic.
Rotate north and kill Prime with Ranged.
Rotate south and kill Supreme with Melee while staying as west as possible.
Move back east before Rex respawns.
risks: Supreme is close to other Kings, so keep movement disciplined.

methods.label: Tribrid fast rotation
methods.summary: Open on Supreme with Melee, then safespot Rex and kill Prime from the north using high damage to control respawns.
steps: Enter and attack Supreme with Melee while avoiding or praying against Prime.
Attack Rex with Magic and drag it to the north-west safespot.
Move north and kill Prime with Ranged.
Attack Supreme again while avoiding Rex by staying north or west.
Return to Rex and repeat.
risks: Low damage causes respawn overlap and high supply drain.

methods.label: Rex-only safespot
methods.summary: Rex safespot remains the recovery or single-boss option even when the current plugin target is Supreme.
steps: Reach the eastern wall.
Attack Rex with Magic and move until it catches on the wall.
Use the safe position to stabilise before continuing Supreme rotations.

methods.label: Prime only
methods.summary: Prime-only ranged positioning is included for alternating or world-control context while tribridding.
steps: Attack Prime from the north-east/eastern side with Ranged.
Stay outside Supreme and Rex aggression range.
Use Telekinetic Grab if drops cannot be collected safely.

methods.label: Max tribrid inventory
methods.summary: High-end tribrid inventory with switches, SGS, Death Charge, boosts, antipoison/restores, emergency healing, route items, and herb sack.
inventory: Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless shortcutting

methods.label: Mid-level tribrid inventory
methods.summary: Mid-level setup with fewer switches, Blood/Ice spell runes, boosts, restores, food, route items, and herb sack.
inventory: Rune pouch for Blood spells and optional Ice spells
Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless shortcutting

methods.label: Rex safespot inventory
methods.summary: Rex-only setup uses Magic, antipoison, prayer, food, teleport, route items, and optional Guthan's sustain.
inventory: Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless shortcutting

methods.label: Early Ironman Rex inventory
methods.summary: Early Rex trips use Iban's staff, tank gear, antipoison, a few prayer potions, teleport, route items, and food.

methods.label: Tips and tricks
methods.summary: Use cannon timing, Waterbirth portal, sustain gear, antipoison, diary, and shortcuts to extend trips.
notes: Use a dwarf multicannon with 1,000-2,000 cannonballs on Prime's spawn and only load it when Prime spawns.
Attune a house portal to Waterbirth.
Guthan's and Saradomin godsword reduce food use.
Ice Barrage can freeze Rex and Blood spells can heal.
Bring antipoison or wear serpentine helm.
Elite Fremennik Diary notes Dagannoth bones.
A godsword can be both special weapon and Supreme weapon if melee stats are high enough.
The 85 Agility shortcut, or 80 with Summer pie, skips rune thrownaxe and pet rock.

styleOptions.summary: Single-player Magic/Ranged/Melee setup for killing all three Kings.

styleOptions.label: Magic Rex only
styleOptions.summary: Magic setup for Rex-only or recovery kills.

styleOptions.label: Ranged Prime only
styleOptions.summary: Prime-only setup carried for full page coverage and tribrid switching context.

body:
# Dagannoth Supreme

Full Dagannoth Kings strategy source with entering, multicombat handling, tribrid rotations, Rex-only, Prime-only, inventories, and trip optimisations. Supreme itself is killed with Melee.
